name: Power Function (Fast Exponentiation)
description: Computes x^n in O(log n) time using binary exponentiation (repeated squaring). Much faster than the naive O(n) multiplication.
aim: Calculate x^n efficiently: if n is even, x^n = (x²)^(n/2); if odd, x^n = x × x^(n-1). Halves the problem each step.
howItWorks: If n is even: return power(x*x, n/2)
If n is odd: return x × power(x*x, (n-1)/2)
Or iteratively: square x and use n's binary representation

complexity.spaceDescription: Recursive stack depth; O(1) for iterative version

realWorld: Matrix fast power for Fibonacci in O(log n)
whenToUse: Large exponents where O(n) is too slow
alternatives: Naive multiplication — O(n) simple but slow
Matrix exponentiation — O(log n) × O(matrix size³)
